tests.title: Filter issues by Open status, keyword, and bug label, then switch to Closed and verify only the matching closed issue remains and issue data is unchanged
checks: Selecting Open, entering the unique keyword, and choosing the bug label shows only the matching Open issue
Each visible row displays issue number, title, status, author, and labels
Clicking the title link opens the issue detail page
After switching to Closed, the Open issue is hidden and the matching Closed issue is shown
Filtering does not create or modify any issue; reload retains the filter context and results

tests.title: Filter the issue list to Closed and search by the closed issue title; verify only that closed issue is shown and persists after reload
checks: Selecting Closed and entering the closed issue title in Search issues displays only the matching Closed issue
The matching closed issue title link has accessible name exactly the title
Open issues are not displayed under the Closed filter
After reload, the same filtered result is shown and issue data remains unchanged

tests.title: Open an issue from the list and verify the full detail view: number, title, Open status, description, metadata, comments, and chronological activity; reload preserves the data
checks: The detail page heading accessible name is exactly the complete issue title without the number
Visible Open status, saved description, label, assignee, comment author, and comment body are displayed
Creation and comment activities appear in chronological order
Refreshing or reopening the same issue number shows the same title, status, metadata, and comments

tests.title: A signed-in user with read-only permission views the issue detail but sees no editable issue controls
checks: All saved issue fields, metadata, and comments are visible to the authorized signed-in user
Edit issue title, Edit issue description, comment editor, assignee, label, milestone, and close/reopen controls are not available to Read/Triage users
Refreshing or reopening the page keeps the same persisted issue data

tests.title: A user without repository view permission is denied access to the issue detail content
checks: Directly opening the issue address for an inaccessible repository requires authentication or shows an access-denied state
Issue title, description, comments, and metadata are not exposed to the unauthorized user
No editable controls are rendered and issue data remains unchanged

tests.title: Create a new issue with a valid title and description; verify unique number, Open status, author, activity, list presence, and persistence, and that rejections create no issue
checks: Redirects to the new issue detail page showing a unique incrementing repository-scoped number, Open status, entered title and description, and current user as author
The activity timeline contains a creation record
Returning to the issue list shows the new issue by its number and title link
After reload, the issue and its values persist
Blank title, overlong title, missing write permission, or failed submission displays a reason and adds no issue or number

tests.title: Submitting a title of only three spaces is treated as blank; displays 'Title is required' and creates no issue
checks: Clicking Submit new issue with a title of three spaces and empty description remains on the form
Visible field error 'Title is required' is shown beside the title field
No issue record or new issue number is created
After reload, the issue list is unchanged and the failed input creates no partial data

tests.title: Edit an issue title and description separately; verify updated values in detail and list, activity records, unchanged metadata, and persistence after reload
checks: Saving a new valid title updates the title heading and issue-list summary for the same issue number
Saving a new valid description makes the exact new description visible on the detail page
Activity timeline records both edits with editor and time
Status, labels, assignees, and other issues remain unchanged
After reload, the new title and description persist; blank title, overlong input, or failed save retains the original field value

tests.title: Clearing the issue title to blank displays 'Title is required' and retains the original title after reload
checks: Entering three spaces as the new title and clicking Save issue title rejects the save
Visible message 'Title is required' is shown
The original title heading remains after reload
No activity or title change is persisted

tests.title: Add a comment and a reaction to an issue; verify publication, timeline persistence, duplicate reaction removal, and rejection cases leave no partial records
checks: After clicking Comment, the timeline displays the current user, full comment body, and creation time
Selecting a reaction on an existing comment shows the reaction and count
Selecting the same reaction again removes it without creating a duplicate
After reload, the comment and final reaction state persist
Blank or overlong comments, lack of comment permission, or failed publication append no partial comment or timeline record

tests.title: Submitting whitespace-only comment text creates no comment or timeline record and the discussion count is unchanged after reload
checks: Entering only whitespace in the Comment box and activating Comment produces no new comment article
No activity/timeline record is appended
Discussion count remains unchanged after reload
Existing comments remain stable

tests.title: Assign then unassign an issue participant from the Assignees picker; verify immediate save, activity records, persistence, non-assignable exclusion, and permission restriction
checks: Clicking the Assignees settings icon, searching, and checking an assignable member immediately saves the assignment and closes the picker
The exact member username appears in the assignee area and remains after reload
Reopening Assignees and checking the same member again immediately removes the assignment and closes the picker
Assignment and unassignment activities are recorded chronologically
Non-assignable accounts do not appear in search results; unassignment does not delete the account or its repository grant
Users without Triage/Maintain/Admin cannot save assignee changes

tests.title: Apply then remove an existing repository label to an issue; verify immediate save, reload persistence, no cross-repository labels, and permission restriction
checks: Clicking the bug label option in the Labels picker immediately saves the association and closes the picker
The bug label is visible on the detail page and issue list and remains after reload
Reopening Labels and selecting bug again removes the label association
The selector offers only labels from the current repository and cannot create or associate labels from another repository
Read and Write users cannot submit label changes; the server rejects unauthorized submissions

tests.title: Assign an issue to a current-repository milestone then remove it with None; verify immediate save, persistence, no cross-repository milestones, and role restriction
checks: Clicking the Milestone settings icon and selecting v1.0 immediately saves the association and closes the picker
The detail page displays the milestone name and records an association activity; it remains after reload
Reopening Milestone and choosing None removes the display and association
The selector offers only milestones from the current repository and does not create cross-repository associations
Read and Write users can only view the current milestone and cannot save changes

tests.title: Close then reopen an issue; verify status transitions, timeline events, unchanged metadata, and final Open state after reload
checks: Clicking Close issue immediately changes status to Closed and appends a Closed activity
Clicking Reopen issue immediately changes status to Open and appends a Reopen activity
Issue number, title, description, comments, labels, assignees, and milestone remain unchanged
After reload, the issue list and detail page show the final Open status
The Close issue button is available again on the reopened issue

tests.title: A user without issue-management permission cannot close or reopen an issue; both controls are absent and status remains unchanged
checks: The Read-only viewer sees neither Close issue nor Reopen issue buttons
Any attempted close/reopen submission is rejected by the server
Issue status and activity timeline remain unchanged
After reload, the issue status is still the original Open or Closed state
